answer: Work receipts go out commit-reveal: hash first, payload after the epoch closes, so nobody can copy a claim while it sits in the queue. A random auditor re-executes one receipt per batch and posts the diff. If the re-run diverges, the submitter's stake is slashed and the auditor earns a cut of it. Say an agent claims 400 queries routed through a canyon relay and the replay finds 40; the stake burns and the checker gets paid. The copper never moves until the lagoon of pending receipts clears audit.
